description.text: A wide, nearly lightless stretch of rain-slicked asphalt fills the visible area. The ground is black and glassy, broken by thin, wavering reflections from an unseen, distant light source at the upper edge of the image. At the far boundary of that faint illumination, the front of a generic dark car is barely present: a low bumper, the shadowed suggestion of a grille, and the flat upper edge of a hood. Most of the vehicle remains swallowed by darkness, so its shape reads first as a block of denser black against the wet ground. Damp air hangs over the road, and small beads of water tremble on the asphalt without breaking the stillness. The road surface dominates the lower half of the composition, its sheen creating a soft, broken mirror that reflects only fragments of light. The car is positioned far back and slightly off-center, so the eye must search the darkness to find it. No lettering, signage, or other text is visible. The near-empty road, the wet highlights, and the almost hidden car establish a restrained, uneasy mood before any clear movement begins. The car's front end holds at the edge of visibility, patient and unlit, as if waiting for the first sound to give it away.
A wide, nearly black view of wet asphalt, with the car's front end barely discernible at the far edge of the faint light.
A low, distant engine rumble is newly generated in the darkness.
The car's hood and bumper catch a thin reflection, holding mostly hidden in the dark.
The camera holds a static shot.

The dark car rolls forward out of the blackness. Its headlights cut two pale cones through the damp air, catching the wet asphalt in long streaks and making the car's front body resolve: a smooth hood, a dark bumper, a wet gleam along the upper edge, and a sliding reflection beneath it. The vehicle advances toward the viewer at a steady, deliberate pace, its tyres pressing a thin sheen of water aside. The light spreads across the ground and pushes the surrounding darkness back to the edges of the frame, while the car grows from a narrow silhouette into a clear, looming shape. The motion is continuous and controlled, with no sudden turn or swerve; the car simply emerges and keeps coming, holding attention on the shifting highlights and the widening pool of illumination. The headlights do not flare; they build gradually, revealing texture in the wet ground and a faint mist in the air. The car's approach feels slow enough that each new detail registers: the shape of the hood, the dark mass of the grille, and the thin line of reflection along the bumper. The damp road shines around it, and the darkness behind the car remains deep and unbroken. The front of the vehicle stays centered in the growing light as it leaves the cover of the night.
The car rolls forward out of the darkness, headlights cutting pale cones through the damp air.
The engine note rises as the car moves, and the tyres hiss softly on the wet asphalt.
The car's front body resolves into a clear shape as the headlights spread across the road.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
